text:
noah: Quick check before I book  flying to London + Edinburgh next month. Can I use my personal card and get reimbursed? Also curious about per-diem and alcohol limits.

sara_people_ops: Yes you can use a personal card if you don't have a corporate card on file, but prefer booking through the Redwood Travel Portal where possible. Submit expenses in Expensify within 14 days and attach receipts.

sara_people_ops: Per-diem: UK trips use the international flat-rate of $120/day USD for meals & incidentals. You can choose per-diem or actual receipts (not both). Travel days are prorated at 75%.

omar: Business class question  my long leg to LHR is ~7.5h. Any rule?

sara_people_ops: Economy is default. Premium economy/business can be approved for single-leg flights >8 hours. For ~7.5h you need manager + People Ops pre-approval with a justification (medical/recovery or work necessity). Attach approval to Expensify.

lena_manager: I can approve if People Ops signs off. Noah, add a short note why you prefer premium.

noah: Lost receipt scenario  I sometimes lose taxi or tube receipts. What's acceptable?

sara_people_ops: Use the Lost Receipt Affidavit in Expensify and include a card statement line showing the charge plus manager attestation. For amounts under $25 we may accept statement + short note without affidavit.

noah: Alcohol  if client orders bottles at dinner, can I claim it?

sara_people_ops: Alcohol is allowed but within reason. Policy: reimbursable up to $30 per-person on meal receipts if itemized. Anything above needs manager approval and a brief business justification. If the client paid, mark the meal as "provided" and don't claim per-diem.

omar: Hotels  I sometimes see cheaper Airbnb options. Allowed?

sara_people_ops: Preferred: Travel Portal hotels (negotiated rates + insurance). Airbnb may be approved for extended stays or when hotel inventory is limited, but requires manager pre-approval and receipts/invoice. No red flags for safety/expense policy.

noah: What about incidental holds from hotels? They put a big pre-auth on my personal card. Will Redwood cover/advance that?

sara_people_ops: Pre-authorizations are not reimbursed as they clear with your card issuer. If an actual charge posts for incidentals, submit the folio and statement line. For corporate card holders, use corporate card for incidentals where possible to avoid personal holds.

finance_bot: Expensify: report "UK client visit - Noah" created by noah  status: needs manager approval. Processing time ~7-10 business days after approvals.

noah: Thanks  I'll book via portal where I can, attach e-tickets + receipts, and ping Lena for the business-class note. :thumbsup:
